title: experimental page: lime on chip, dim off chip, one focus mark
why: The critic scored the experimental page 2: on and off chips looked alike, the detail pane repeated the chip, focus was stacked four ways, the footer was 13px and the last row was cut. Now on is a lime chip and off a dim one, the detail pane drops the repeated chip, the lime row bar is the only focus mark, the footer is 16px and the list has 72px of bottom padding.
now: The experimental page shows on as a lime chip and off as a dim one, with one focus mark and a readable footer.
